_readme: SGR-004 vocabularies, fixed on 2026-10-04 BEFORE any page was measured, so the lists could not be tuned to the result. Each entry is matched case-insensitively on word boundaries; a trailing * matches any ending (seamless* = seamless, seamlessly). Counts are reported per 1,000 words. 'ai_era' is words widely reported as over-used by large language models in marketing and explanatory copy. 'dotcom_corporate' is the stock vocabulary of 2000s corporate sites. Neither list says a page was written by AI; they track vocabulary only.
